targets.rawSql:
SELECT device_id,
       plant_id,
       point_id,
       telemetry_topic,
       cmd_topic_pattern,
       expected_client_id,
       report_interval_sec,
       align_mode,
       enabled,
       last_seen_at,
       created_at,
       '编辑' AS edit,
       '删除' AS delete
FROM admin_api.v_device_conn_profile
ORDER BY created_at DESC
LIMIT 300;

targets.rawSql: SELECT device_id, point_id, report_interval_sec, align_mode, enabled FROM device WHERE device_id = ${edit_device_id:sqlstring} LIMIT 1;
SELECT '' AS value, '（新建）' AS label UNION ALL SELECT device_id AS value, device_id AS label FROM device ORDER BY label;
SELECT pt.point_id AS value, (pt.plant_id || ' / ' || pt.point_id) AS label FROM point pt ORDER BY pt.plant_id, pt.point_id;
